priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore message listener removal
findings.body: Calling the function returned by attach no longer unregisters the handler. Detached consumers will continue receiving messages, and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners, causing duplicate processing and memory leaks.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns a no-op disposer after registering the message handler on line 2. The full diff confirms this PR replaced the prior socket.off("message", handler) cleanup, so invoking the returned function cannot unregister the listener.
